_comment: Microsoft Graph Security API custom detection rules. Deploy each element of 'detectionRules' with POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/security/rules/detectionRules (app scope: CustomDetection.ReadWrite.All). KQL targets the Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting schema. Response actions execute automatically when a rule matches; scope them per your auto-containment tolerance before enabling in production.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-01 Ransomware: mass file encryption behavior

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ActionType == "FileRenamed" or ActionType == "FileModified"
| where FileName matches regex @"(?i)\.(locked|crypt|encrypted|enc|[a-z0-9]{6,10})$"
| summarize AffectedFiles = dcount(FolderPath), FileNames = make_set(FileName, 25) by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where AffectedFiles >= 200
| extend ReportId = tostring(hash(strcat(DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, Timestamp)))

alertTemplate.title: Ransomware: mass file encryption on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: A single process modified or renamed 200+ files in 5 minutes with encryption-style extensions, consistent with ransomware detonation.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Confirm host is isolated. Identify the encrypting process and parent chain, preserve memory, and begin recovery from clean backups. Hunt for lateral spread.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-02 Credential dumping: LSASS memory access

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ActionType == "OpenProcessApiCall" or ActionType == "ReadProcessMemoryApiCall"
| where FileName =~ "lsass.exe"
| where not(InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\\windows\\system32\\", @"\\program files\\windows defender\\"))
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe", "csrss.exe", "wininit.exe", "services.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountSid

alertTemplate.title: LSASS credential dumping attempt on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: A non-system process opened or read LSASS process memory, a hallmark of credential theft (Mimikatz, comsvcs.dll, procdump).
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Treat all credentials used on this host as compromised. Isolate, collect investigation package, force password resets for logged-on accounts, and hunt for downstream authentication.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-03 Office application spawned suspicious child process

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe", "mspub.exe", "onenote.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, AccountUpn, AccountSid

alertTemplate.title: Office macro execution: {InitiatingProcessFileName} spawned {FileName} on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: An Office application launched a scripting or living-off-the-land binary, typical of a malicious macro or embedded payload.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Retrieve the originating document and email, detonate in a sandbox, and hunt for the same attachment across mailboxes. Host isolated pending triage.

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-enc", "-encodedcommand", "-e ", "frombase64string", "-w hidden", "-windowstyle hidden", "iex", "invoke-expression", "downloadstring", "downloadfile", "-nop", "-noprofile")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-e(nc(odedcommand)?)?\s+[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,}" or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("downloadstring", "downloadfile", "frombase64string")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountUpn, AccountSid

alertTemplate.title: Encoded/obfuscated PowerShell on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: PowerShell ran with encoded, hidden, or download-and-execute patterns commonly used to stage payloads.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Decode the command line, resolve any remote URLs against threat intel, and review parent process. Investigation package collected for offline analysis.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-05 Inhibit recovery: volume shadow copy deletion

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
    or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
    or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
    or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountUpn, AccountSid

alertTemplate.title: Shadow copy / backup deletion on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: A process deleted volume shadow copies or disabled recovery, a common ransomware precursor to prevent restoration.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Treat as active ransomware staging. Host isolated. Verify backups are intact and offline, and hunt for the encryption stage.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-06 Persistence: suspicious scheduled task creation

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "/create"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("powershell", "cmd", "wscript", "cscript", "mshta", "rundll32", "regsvr32", "\\users\\public", "\\appdata\\", "\\programdata\\", "-enc", "downloadstring")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountUpn, AccountSid

alertTemplate.title: Suspicious scheduled task created on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: A scheduled task was created that runs a scripting engine or a binary from a user-writable path, a common persistence mechanism.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the task action and trigger, correlate with recent execution, and remove if unauthorized.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-07 Persistence: registry Run key autorun modification

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet", "RegistryKeyCreated")
| where RegistryKey has_any (@"\\CurrentVersion\\Run", @"\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce", @"\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Shell Folders", @"\\Winlogon\\Shell", @"\\Winlogon\\Userinit")
| where RegistryValueData has_any ("\\appdata\\", "\\programdata\\", "\\users\\public", "\\temp\\", "powershell", "mshta", "rundll32", "regsvr32", "-enc")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn

alertTemplate.title: Autorun persistence written on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: A registry Run/Winlogon autostart value was set to a suspicious path or interpreter.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Validate the referenced binary, check its signature and reputation, and remove the value if malicious.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-08 Lateral movement: remote service / PsExec execution

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where (FileName in~ ("psexec.exe", "psexesvc.exe", "paexec.exe")) 
    or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "services.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-s -d -f", "cmd.exe /c", "powershell") and FolderPath has_any ("\\windows\\", "\\temp\\"))
    or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\\\", "create", "binpath"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteUrl=column_ifexists("RemoteUrl",""), AccountUpn, AccountSid

alertTemplate.title: Remote service execution / lateral movement on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: PsExec-style remote service creation or execution observed, indicating possible lateral movement.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Identify the source host and account, map the movement graph, and confirm whether the account is authorized for admin operations. Investigation package collected.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-09 LOLBin download / ingress tool transfer

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where (FileName =~ "certutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-urlcache", "-verifyctl", "-decode"))
    or (FileName =~ "bitsadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "transfer")
    or (FileName =~ "mshta.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://", "https://", "javascript:", "vbscript:"))
    or (FileName =~ "curl.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-o ", "--output") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\temp\\", "\\appdata\\", "\\programdata\\"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountUpn, AccountSid

alertTemplate.title: LOLBin remote download on {DeviceName}
alertTemplate.description: A trusted system binary was used to download or decode a remote file, a common payload-staging technique.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Extract and reputation-check the remote URL and the dropped file. Quarantine the file if malicious.

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(3h)
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess" and RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe", "msedge.exe", "firefox.exe", "outlook.exe", "teams.exe", "onedrive.exe")
| summarize Connections = count(), Beats = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1m)), Bytes = sum(column_ifexists("SentBytes", 0)) by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, bin(Timestamp, 3h)
| where Connections >= 30 and Beats >= 20
| extend ReportId = tostring(hash(strcat(DeviceId, RemoteIP, Timestamp)))

alertTemplate.title: Possible C2 beaconing from {DeviceName} to {RemoteIP}
alertTemplate.description: A non-browser process made regular, repeated connections to a single public host, consistent with C2 beaconing.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Reputation-check the destination, review process lineage, and pivot on other hosts contacting the same infrastructure. Investigation package collected.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-11 Identity takeover: impossible travel sign-in

queryCondition.queryText:
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| sort by AccountObjectId asc, Timestamp asc
| extend PrevCountry = prev(Country), PrevTime = prev(Timestamp), PrevAccount = prev(AccountObjectId)
| where AccountObjectId == PrevAccount and Country != PrevCountry and isnotempty(PrevCountry)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, PrevTime)
| where GapMinutes <= 240
| project Timestamp, AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, AccountDisplayName, Country, PrevCountry, GapMinutes, IPAddress, City, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Impossible travel sign-in for {AccountUpn}
alertTemplate.description: Successful sign-ins from two geographically distant countries within a window too short for physical travel, indicating likely account compromise.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: User account disabled automatically. Revoke sessions, reset credentials, and review sign-in and mailbox activity before re-enabling.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-12 Password spray against Entra ID

queryCondition.queryText:
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ErrorCode in (50126, 50053, 50055, 50056)
| summarize TargetedAccounts = dcount(AccountObjectId), Attempts = count(), Accounts = make_set(AccountUpn, 50) by IPAddress, bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| where TargetedAccounts >= 15
| extend ReportId = tostring(hash(strcat(IPAddress, Timestamp)))

alertTemplate.title: Password spray from {IPAddress}
alertTemplate.description: A single source IP failed authentication against many distinct accounts in a short window, consistent with password spraying.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Block the source IP, confirm no account succeeded, and enforce MFA / smart lockout. Review any subsequent successful sign-in from the same IP.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-13 Privileged directory group membership change

queryCondition.queryText:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where ActionType in ("Group Membership changed", "Member added to group", "Security-enabled group member added")
| extend TargetGroup = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).["TO.GROUP"])
| where TargetGroup has_any ("Domain Admins", "Enterprise Admins", "Schema Admins", "Administrators", "Account Operators", "Backup Operators", "Global Administrator", "Privileged Role Administrator")
| project Timestamp, ReportId, ActionType, TargetGroup, TargetAccountUpn=TargetAccountDisplayName, AccountUpn, AccountDisplayName, DeviceName, IPAddress

alertTemplate.title: Privileged group change: member added to {TargetGroup}
alertTemplate.description: An account was added to a highly privileged directory group. Verify against an approved change.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Confirm the change was authorized via change management. If not, remove the membership and investigate the actor account.

queryCondition.queryText:
IdentityLogonEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where Protocol == "Kerberos" and LogonType == "Service"
| extend Encryption = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).EncryptionType)
| summarize DistinctSpns = dcount(TargetDeviceName), WeakEnc = countif(Encryption in ("RC4-HMAC", "DES")), Requests = count() by AccountUpn, AccountSid, DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 15m)
| where DistinctSpns >= 10 or (WeakEnc >= 5 and DistinctSpns >= 5)
| extend ReportId = tostring(hash(strcat(AccountSid, Timestamp)))

alertTemplate.title: Possible Kerberoasting by {AccountUpn}
alertTemplate.description: One account requested service tickets for many distinct SPNs, disproportionately with weak (RC4) encryption, consistent with Kerberoasting for offline cracking.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Review the account's normal behavior, rotate service account passwords with strong secrets, and prioritize SPNs on high-value services.

detectionRules.displayName: CD-15 Malicious attachment delivered to mailbox

queryCondition.queryText:
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1h)
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where DeliveryAction in ("Delivered", "DeliveredAsSpam")
| join kind=inner (
    EmailAttachmentInfo
    | where FileType in~ ("exe", "scr", "js", "vbs", "hta", "iso", "img", "lnk", "docm", "xlsm", "pptm", "one")
        or ThreatTypes has_any ("Malware", "Phish")
) on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, ReportId, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, Subject, FileName, FileType, SHA256, ThreatTypes, DeliveryAction

alertTemplate.title: Malicious attachment delivered to {RecipientEmailAddress}
alertTemplate.description: An inbound email with a high-risk or flagged attachment was delivered to a mailbox.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Soft-delete the message across all mailboxes (purge), block the sender and hash, and check whether the attachment was opened on any endpoint (pivot on SHA256).
